round: Review round 16: two regression tests for round 15's lock fixes, and a merge of main for #2640 (8d1eb630; README conflict only, resolved with main's line breaks and this PR's wording). One code push, fccd461a. No runtime file changed.

proof.criterion: A compaction that does not wait holds no room lock while it waits for a compaction-pool connection; a waiting compaction whose read fails still waits for the room's lock
proof.surface: go test of the docs package on a local Postgres 16.2 (GOMAXPROCS=4, GOMEMLIMIT=12GiB)
proof.command: go test -p 1 -count=10 -timeout 20m ./internal/dispatch/docs -run '^(TestACompactionThatDoesNotWaitHoldsNoRoomLockWhileItWaitsForAConnection|TestAWaitingCompactionWhoseReadFailedStillWaitsForTheRoomsLock)$', and the same with CGO_ENABLED=1 -race
proof.observed: Both tests pass 10 of 10 runs, and 10 of 10 under -race. The compaction, sweep, failed-room and stored-order tests of the docs package pass, and so does cmd/dispatch's stored-order test.
proof.negativeControl: With the passRoomLock call removed from compactRoom's read-error path, TestAWaitingCompactionWhoseReadFailedStillWaitsForTheRoomsLock fails: 'the compaction whose read failed returned ... without waiting for the document's lock' (run by me). With lockRoom's old order restored (TryLock before Acquire), TestACompactionThatDoesNotWaitHoldsNoRoomLockWhileItWaitsForAConnection fails: 'the append never landed while the compaction waited for a compaction-pool connection' (run by the worker; the output is in the diff-check comment).

proof.criterion: The merge keeps the PR's file set, and the real process compacts as before
proof.surface: jj diff of the PR against its base before and after; real envoy-dispatch with NATS off and its stored-order command
proof.command: jj diff --from fork_point(main@origin|<head>) --to <head> --name-only (693a2c44, 8d1eb630, fccd461a); bash $TMPDIR/infra593/e2e.sh; envoy-dispatch stored-order --artifact <document> (dispatch://INFRA-593/artifact/infra-593-e2e-proof-txt v25)
proof.observed: The same 81 paths before, after the merge and at the head; the only changelog fragment is pr2444-document-load-and-compaction.yaml. The e2e run: 41 rows; the restarted process's sweep logged candidates=1 compacted=1 rows_deleted=37, leaving 4 rows; the 3 young rows are unchanged; the text is identical. stored-order: versions_checked=1 versions_compacted=31, clean=1. bun scripts/semantic-line-breaks.ts reports nothing for cmd/dispatch/README.md.
proof.negativeControl: Before the merge GitHub reported the pull request CONFLICTING (review round 16); at fccd461a it reports MERGEABLE.
